name: Frames of Silence
description: An aspiring actress is pulled into a celebrated director's games, where art and mentorship blur into manipulation.
note: Made at the New York Film Academy for $696. On the festival circuit.

name: Love Is Stronger Than Hate
description: Two best friends drift apart when one of them finds Holocaust artifacts that belonged to her great-grandmother and grows deeper in her faith.
note: Written and directed by Yoey Garfield.
honors: Winner, Best Costume Design, Follow Your Heart Film Festival, Miami 2026
Nominee, Best Drama Short, The North Film Festival NYC 2026
Nominee, Best Student Story, Long Island International Film Expo 2026
Finalist, Best Student Film, New York International Film Awards, October 2025

name: Unspoken Distance
description: A young couple sit in their dim living room, heavy with everything neither of them will say. A montage short.
note: A montage exercise at the New York Film Academy, shot in New Jersey on a Sony FS5.
honors: Official Selection, First-Time Filmmaker Sessions Volume 13, Lift-Off
Official Selection, First-Time Filmmaker Sessions Volume 12, Lift-Off

name: The Last Pizza
description: On his last delivery of the night, a pizza guy gets trapped on a freezing Manhattan rooftop with a dying phone and nothing but the order.
note: Shot on New York rooftops for $50.
honors: Official Selection, First-Time Sessions Volume 11, Lift-Off
Official Selection, Filmmaker Sessions Volume 11, Lift-Off

name: Agent X
description: An agent offers a prisoner serving a life sentence a second chance, if he signs his life over as the agent's hitman. An interrogation scene shot on RED Komodo.
note: Shot on RED Komodo on a studio set built as a cell, at a New York Film Academy production workshop.

name: Before We Leave
description: Two people on a park bench and almost nothing said: a Chekhovian short built from two or three words of dialogue.
note: Shot in one day at the New York Film Academy, with a skeleton crew and no budget.
